title: Active Plugin
description: Current plugin focus state for session tracking

plugin.description: Currently focused plugin name (null if none)

focusedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when focus was set (null if no plugin focused)

currentPlan.description: Path to currently active plan file

currentContext.description: Path to currently active context file

loadedContext.description: Context loaded for the focused plugin (null if not yet loaded)
